title: Open Label Study To Assess The Effectiveness Of Amlodipine-Atorvastatin Combination In Hypertension And Dyslipidemia.
brief_summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of amlodipine/atorvastatin therapy by assessing the percentage of subjects who reach target blood pressure (BP) and LDL-C targets as defined by their governing guidelines.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Treated or untreated subjects with concurrent hypertension and dyslipidemia with BP and LDL-C not at target according to governing guidelines

Exclusion Criteria:

* High liver enzymes
